last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription insomnia and sleep self-management topics. The main query set returned 181 unique PubMed PMIDs, 180 fetched article records, and 180 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMIDs: 30264137, 31968068, 34163383, 40664502, 36000763, 40462685, 35089982, 28884877, and 38422316. Nine retained references were added across 9 new entries. New entries cover digital cognitive behavioral therapy, exercise, aerobic exercise, music listening, valerian·hops, blue-light blocking, self-administered acupressure, and foot massage. Cognitive behavioral therapy, internet CBT-I, sleep hygiene, mindfulness, yoga, tai chi, breathing, aromatherapy, lavender, chamomile, melatonin, magnesium, ashwagandha, tart cherry, bright light, weighted blanket, and acupuncture topics were linked to existing entries. Resistance exercise, relaxation, glycine, L-theanine, and sauna topics were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect.
